summary: Post-fix task grill of postgres-warehouse-adapter (implementation already complete). A false-green in the required_tests gate was found and fixed under decision 0009: required_tests now name real leaf tests and pin TS_NODE_PROJECT=backend/tsconfig.json. A fresh read-only Codex (gpt-5.6-terra @ xhigh) cold-read confirmed all three required_tests are genuine (each id matches a real test(...) call; each filtered run executed one real assertion and passed) and that acceptance c1/c2/c4 are met by the implemented code (adapter implements the Warehouse port; warehouseDriver=postgres dispatches to PostgresAdapter in the core factory; typed warehouse.postgres config isolated from cfg.pg; validator postgresql at all three parse sites; pure exported pgOidIsNumeric fills columns[].numeric). current_flow: The vendored Pulse backend reaches its analytical warehouse through the Warehouse port and shipped only StarRocks adapters with a mysql-dialect SQL validator. This task added a PostgresAdapter (selected by warehouseDriver=postgres in the core factory), a typed warehouse.postgres config isolated from the app DB cfg.pg, flipped the validator to the postgresql dialect at all three parse sites, and added an isolated warehouse-db docker-compose service with a numeric seed. Hermetic proofs: build/typecheck + PII-block-under-postgresql + PostgreSQL-FILTER-accepted + pure OID->numeric mapping. Demonstrated evidence: the opt-in app-path E2E against the live warehouse-db.
